messages:
maya_cs: Quick sync — Nimbus (acct: NIM-001) renewal in ~30 days. We committed Dedicated pool + autoscale; need a final bring-up + renewal smoke test next Wed 03:00 PDT. Objectives: validate quota/limits, trigger autoscale end-to-end, capture latency/cost deltas, and run a short enablement session to capture customer feedback.

sam_eng: I can take quota priming and the autoscale policy check. What traffic profile should we run?

maya_cs: Prod-like: sustained ~120 QPS, avg 512 tokens, occasional 2k-token generative spikes for ~5% of requests. Target headroom = 30% before we consider upsell warning.

leo_oncall: I'll monitor SLOs and KV cache warmup during the run. Add me to any pager hooks.

olivia_pm: For the enablement piece, we'll need a 30m walkthrough for their infra and a short feedback form. I'll draft the survey.

maya_cs: Thanks. I created a short checklist:
```
- quota requested: 8 gpus reserved (pool: rdx-gpu-a1)
- autoscale policy: min=4, target_util=0.65, max=12
- warmup: run 2x prefix priming, 15m each
- smoke script: 20m steady + 2x 3m spike windows
- telemetry: tokens/sec, p95 latency, OOMs, cost-per-token
```

sam_eng: That looks good. I'll push the autoscale policy to staging and run a dry replay. Sharing a tiny k6 snippet for the steady profile: 
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function () {
  http.post('https://loadproxy.internal/replay', JSON.stringify({qps:120, tokens:512}));
  sleep(0.008); // ~120 QPS
}
```

jen_devex: Heads-up — if you need a replay of their real traces, I can convert their anonymized trace into our format. ETA a few hours.

opsbot: Scheduled load job created: job_id=job-789; window=2026-05-06T10:00:00Z; owner=sam_eng. Notifications will post to #eng-oncall.

leo_oncall: I'll subscribe to job-789 and add a quick Grafana dashboard link. Can someone post the model name/version they'll serve?

maya_cs: Model pinned to `rw-instruct-3b-v2` for the run. We'll test fallback policy to `rw-instruct-3b-quant` if memory pressure occurs.

olivia_pm: Survey draft: 6 quick Qs on latency sensitivity, error tolerance, cost tradeoffs, and docs clarity. Will share before EOD.

sam_eng: Plan for canary traffic shift during the run: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 15m if metrics stable. I'll put the rollout steps in the runbook.

maya_cs: Action items:
- sam_eng: push autoscale policy to staging + run dry replay (due: Tue 18:00 PDT)
- jen_devex: convert trace + handoff load script (due: Tue 20:00 PDT)
- leo_oncall: dashboards + pager connections (due: Wed 01:00 PDT)
- olivia_pm: enablement survey + 30m agenda (due: Tue EOD)
- maya_cs: runbook + renewal note for customer success thread (I'll send)

maya_cs: Please react with :thumbsup: when you've taken ownership so I can update the checklist.
